title: Suction cup unit for gripping workpieces

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: A suction cup unit for gripping workpieces comprises a suction cup member carried by a support body within which a device is arranged for autonomously generating a vacuum to be applied to the suction cup member.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum generating device arranged within the support body (housing) of the suction cup unit, which includes an electrically-operated valve.
features.refuted: The quote describes a vacuum generating device but does not specify that it is electrically operated.

features.note: The reference discloses exhaust air being discharged to an outlet, but does not mention it being guided through a hollow grip portion.

features.note: The reference indicates that the reservoir, part of the vacuum generating device, is inside the support body. It does not explicitly define 'first housing portion' or state that the *entire* vacuum generating device is in one such portion.
